metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD 2.8.2 Loading Screens Uninstaller (GTA V Legacy)
metadata.description:
Takes FBICat's VI loading screens off GTA V LEGACY (GTA5.exe) and puts the game's own back. Maintained by Geckomacabre. Install it with OpenIV, to the mods folder, the same way you installed the loading screens. Game in C:\Program Files? Start OpenIV with right-click > Run as administrator.
Need help? discord.gg/C7gE5SHEzH, or a GitHub issue.
What it does In update.rpf\x64\data\cdimages\scaleform_frontend.rpf (your mods folder's copy): - Puts back Rockstar's own landing page and loading screens: landing_page.gfx, loadingscreen_startup.gfx, loadingscreen_newgame.gfx and gtav_online.gfx, as the game has them. - Deletes the VI pictures, viload_0.ytd to viload_11.ytd and viload_logo.ytd. Works for the loading screens of any version, whether they came in their own package or (up to 2.6.4) in the HUD's.
What it leaves - The HUD itself. It works the same with the game's own loading screens. - The HUD's notification movie in the same file (game_stream.gfx), so its notifications stay clear of the minimap. - Your other mods.
The four movies are Rockstar's, unchanged, from GTA V's own update.rpf: the only way to put them back. https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
metadata.licence: Personal use. Puts GTA V's own loading screens back; the four movies in it are Rockstar Games' own, unchanged.
